card.name: Dose units like mg and milligram
card.fires_on: Dose unit words such as mg, mEq and the middle of milligram right after a number or in a dosing phrase. Also the word Swallow before tablets or capsules whole.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The unit mg, mEq or milligram-per-milligram right after a strength number in dosing text.

modes.label: Swallow whole
modes.description: The middle of the word Swallow in instructions to swallow tablets or capsules whole.
